cases.sentence: О Бог отмщения! ___, Бог отмщения, яви Себя!
cases.explain: Господь is the subject of the imperative verb яви (shine), so it takes the nominative case.
The preposition по (according to) governing the dative case.

cases.sentence: Они сокрушают Твой ___ и угнетают Твое наследие.
cases.explain: Народ is the direct object of the transitive verb сокрушают (break), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Они убивают вдов и чужеземцев и умерщвляют ___ и говорят...
cases.explain: Сирот is the direct object of the transitive verb умерщвляют (murder), so it takes the accusative case.
The verb учит (teaches) with the meaning of instructing in something governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Благословен человек, которого ты, Господи, наставляешь и учишь своему ___.
cases.explain: The verb учишь (teach) with the dative complement governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Ведь не покинет Господь ___ своего и наследие своего не бросит.
cases.explain: After the negated perfective verb покинет in the sense of abandonment, the genitive is used.

cases.sentence: Когда я сказал, колеблется моя ___, твоя милость, Господи, поддержала меня.
cases.explain: Нога is the grammatical subject of the verb колеблется (is slipping), so it takes the nominative case.

reading.ru: Поднимись, Судья Вселенной, воздай гордым по их делам!
reading.question: What does the psalmist ask the Judge of the universe to do?
options: Rise and pay back the proud according to their deeds
reading.correct: Rise and pay back the proud according to their deeds
reading.explain: The text says 'Поднимись, Судья Вселенной, воздай гордым по их делам' — Rise, Judge of the universe, pay back the proud according to their deeds.

reading.ru: Они произносят свои дерзкие речи, превозносятся все злодеи.
reading.question: How do the evildoers conduct themselves according to this verse?
options: They speak arrogant words and boast
reading.correct: They speak arrogant words and boast
reading.explain: Они произносят свои дерзкие речи, превозносятся все злодеи — They pour out arrogant words and all the evildoers boast.

reading.ru: Они убивают вдов и чужеземцев и умерщвляют сирот и говорят, Господь не увидит и не обратит внимания Бог Иакова.
reading.question: What crimes do the wicked commit, and what false claim do they make?
options: They kill widows, aliens, and orphans, and falsely claim God doesn't see or care
reading.correct: They kill widows, aliens, and orphans, and falsely claim God doesn't see or care
reading.explain: The text explicitly lists these victims and records the false belief: 'Господь не увидит и не обратит внимания' — the Lord will not see and will not consider.

reading.ru: Давший ухо разве не услышит? Сотворивший глаз разве не увидит?
reading.question: What rhetorical questions does the psalmist ask about God's nature?
options: If God gave ears, won't he hear? If he formed eyes, won't he see?
Does God have ears and eyes?
Why doesn't God use his senses?
Are human senses better than God's?
reading.correct: If God gave ears, won't he hear? If he formed eyes, won't he see?
reading.explain: The rhetorical structure emphasizes God's perception: 'Давший ухо разве не услышит?' — He who implanted the ear, won't he hear?

reading.ru: Благословен человек, которого ты, Господи, наставляешь и учишь своему закону, чтобы дать ему покой в дни бедствия.
reading.question: What blessing does the psalmist describe for those taught by God?
options: They receive rest from adversity through God's instruction in his law
reading.correct: They receive rest from adversity through God's instruction in his law
reading.explain: Благословен человек...учишь своему закону, чтобы дать ему покой в дни бедствия — Blessed is the man taught God's law, to give him rest in days of adversity.

reading.ru: Если бы не был Господь мне помощником, поселилась бы моя душа в земле молчания.
reading.question: What would have happened to the psalmist if God had not been his helper?
options: His soul would have dwelt in the land of silence (death)
He would have conquered his enemies
He would have traveled to distant lands
reading.correct: His soul would have dwelt in the land of silence (death)
reading.explain: земле молчания — the land of silence is a metaphor for death or Sheol, expressing what would have happened without God's help.
